blocks.html: During the demolition of a building where one or more floors are removed from the building, all floors in the building that are closed to the public and that are more than 7 stories or 75 feet (22 860 mm) below the topmost working deck, whichever is less, shall be served by an elevator or hoist meeting the requirements of this section.
